Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.           

About the role

As a Health AI Engineer I, you will contribute to the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms designed to address meaningful healthcare and product challenges. Working alongside experienced AI/ML engineers, data scientists, clinical experts, and R&D partners, you will help transform healthcare data into algorithms that can be evaluated and ultimately incorporated into medical technology solutions.

This is an entry-level role designed for an engineer who wants to build strong technical foundations in AI/ML while learning how algorithms are developed in a regulated, safety-critical healthcare environment. You will contribute throughout the algorithm development lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, experimentation, evaluation, error analysis, and technical documentation.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities will include:
Develop, implement, train, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning algorithms under the guidance of experienced AI/ML engineers and technical leads.
Support development of algorithms for healthcare applications, which may include medical imaging, physiological signals, clinical data, multimodal data, or other data generated by medical technologies.
Prepare and curate datasets for algorithm development, including data cleaning, preprocessing, quality checks, annotation/label review, and dataset characterization.
Develop reproducible data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation pipelines using modern AI/ML frameworks and software engineering practices.
Conduct algorithm experiments, tune model parameters, compare alternative approaches, and document experimental results and technical decisions.
Evaluate algorithm performance using appropriate technical and clinically meaningful metrics and contribute to error analysis, robustness testing, subgroup analysis, and identification of potential model limitations.
Create clear visualizations and technical summaries to communicate algorithm performance, tradeoffs, and experimental findings to technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, version control, model and dataset versioning, and other practices that improve the quality and reproducibility of AI development.
Support technical documentation and evidence generation for algorithm design, evaluation, Responsible AI, and product development activities.
Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, Clinical, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Cybersecurity, and other partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical approaches.
Stay current with relevant developments in machine learning, healthcare AI, and emerging AI technologies and apply appropriate methods to development activities.
Required Qualifications
Must graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering in May 2027.
Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without company sponsorship, now or in the future, for employment-based work authorization
Must have prior engineering internship experience from Boston Scientific
Must have minimum of 1 year of work experience in MedTech
Foundational knowledge of machine learning concepts, including model training, validation, evaluation, and common performance metrics.
Programming experience in Python or a comparable language through coursework, research, projects, internships, or professional experience.
Experience with or exposure to common machine learning/deep learning frameworks and data analysis tools.
Ability to analyze technical problems, work with data, and communicate findings clearly.
Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and multidisciplinary teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience developing machine learning or deep learning models through academic projects, research, internships, or other technical work.
Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar AI/ML frameworks.
Familiarity with computer vision, medical imaging, time-series/signal processing, natural language processing, multimodal AI, or related algorithm-development techniques.
Exposure to medical imaging formats such as DICOM or healthcare/clinical datasets.
Familiarity with Git, software testing, experiment tracking, containers, cloud computing, or MLOps practices.
Understanding of statistical methods and experimental design used to evaluate algorithm performance.
Familiarity with healthcare AI and developing AI systems for regulated, safety-critical environments.
Interest in Responsible AI concepts such as model performance, robustness, transparency, bias/fairness, and ongoing monitoring.
Strong documentation habits and ability to clearly communicate technical methods, results, and limitations.

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions.
